description.value: Pizza Coming Soon is an evening pizzeria tucked into Vancouver's historic Chinatown on East Pender Street, operating under the parent company Laughing Seal Dreams Worldwide Enterprises Inc. It offers dine-in service alongside delivery through DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Skip the Dishes. The restaurant has a no-smoking policy and accepts reservations for larger groups via email.
